summary: Coincheck Group N.V. (Nasdaq: CNCK), a Dutch-domiciled crypto-asset financial services holding company that reports as a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K, announced via press release, effective September 17, 2026, that Executive Chairperson Takashi Oyagi resigned as Executive Director and Chair of the Board, will not stand for re-election at the September 25, 2026 annual general meeting, and agenda item 4.a is withdrawn from the shareholder vote. The Board appointed Chief Stakeholder Officer Satoshi Hasuo as temporary replacement Executive Director, while CEO and President Pascal St-Jean assumes Executive Chairperson duties. The company disclosed no disagreement with management or the Board and named no advisor. No financial terms apply. Watch for permanent board composition and governance stability.
